search_verification.note: All 2,069 closed author PR records were fetched in four disjoint created-date partitions, each below the 1,000-result search cap. All 23 pages were complete and unique. A separate complete 15-page merged-index inventory contains 1,327 PRs; its exact omissions are Geoopt #258/#259 and Craft Anything #1505, each directly reverified. Four historical ONNX Runtime PRs remain inaccessible and retain the pinned baseline evidence.

ranking_verification.method: Official rendered GitHub Contributors graph: All / Commits / default branch. Read the exact printed Afloat16 card rank. Absence requires a complete displayed top-100 check. Never infer graph positions from PR counts, author histories or REST order.
